about: Hand-curated venue research for the Acco festival, keyed by our venue id (the programme pages name no venue ids). Not edition-specific: a hall outlives a programme. Every figure is {value, source} with the URL it was read from; a figure nobody could cite is null, never estimated. Names are the festival's own Hebrew; the street zones take theirs from the street programme's section headings instead.

acco-theatre-centre.name: המרכז לתיאטרון עכו
acco-theatre-centre.notes: Inside the Knights' Halls complex, so it shares that building's pin: the place pin of the Google Maps link on the municipality's festival page. The theatre's own page gives each hall's size as approximate ("כ-120 איש"), and describes the red hall as having no raised seating ("ללא יציעים"). The programme page does not say which hall a ticketed show plays; only the free foyer concerts name theirs.

knights-halls.name: אולמות האבירים
knights-halls.notes: The Hospitaller citadel. The pin is the place pin of the Google Maps link on the municipality's festival page (read through a fetch summary, not the page bytes). It hosts the paid night light-and-sound show.

weizmann-st.notes: A street zone of the free programme, outside the Knights' Halls. No citable coordinate.

well-compound.notes: A street zone of the free programme. No citable coordinate or address.

knights-halls-car-park.notes: A street zone of the free programme, the car park beside the Knights' Halls. No citable coordinate.

lower-moat.notes: A street zone of the free programme, in the moat of the Old City walls. No citable coordinate.

night-stage.notes: The street programme's late-evening band stage, listed beside the lower moat. No citable coordinate.
